ns2:course.label: Private Pilot II
ns2:course.description: Second of a two course sequence to prepare for FAA Private Pilot certification. Includes classroom instruction on airplane operation, navigation, night flying and meteorology. Includes 34.5 hours of flight training and 3 hours in a flight simulator in the flight laboratory. Students enrolling in this course will also participate in up to 5 hours of research flight experiments. Students successfully completing final examinations will be issued a Private Pilot certificate. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Credit is not given for both AVI 120 and AVI 121. Prerequisite: AVI 101 and consent of director.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Credit is not given for both AVI 120 and AVI 121. Prerequisite: AVI 101 and consent of director.
